title: Tagine Stew with Datterini Tomatoes
description: A hearty, comforting stew inspired by traditional North African cuisine, featuring tender beef and sweet Datterini tomatoes.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown beef in batches, then set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and cook onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add beef broth and bring to a boil.
Return beef to the pot and add datterini tomatoes, tagine spice blend, and salt.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
